key_findings.claim: NAMI-NYC Corporate Giving: Strong fit. NAMI-NYC has strong mission alignment through mental-health education and support. Its corporate-giving page is an indirect prospect-research lead, not evidence that NAMI-NYC or its listed business partners will sponsor the foundation.

NAMIWalks NYC 2026: Needs research. This could become a useful mental-health sponsor-research lead, but the substantive information is snippet-only. It does not yet identify a verified business prospect for the foundation's gala.

National Eating Disorders Association Gala 2026: Possible fit. This Manhattan event is a relevant historical lead for businesses interested in eating-disorder philanthropy. The supplied excerpt does not verify the named sponsors or establish their willingness to support another foundation.

Project Healthy Minds Annual Gala 2026: Strong fit. The gala has strong mental-health awareness alignment and a Manhattan business audience. It is a prospect-research route rather than a spring event match or a confirmed source of sponsorship funding.

StrongSteps Behavioral Health: Needs research. The snippet suggests a mental-health connection, but this is a low-priority lead because geography and all substantive offerings remain unverified. Nothing supplied identifies a Manhattan business sponsor for the foundation.

Manhattan Chamber of Commerce: Possible fit. This is the strongest geographic and business-network match for the request, although its direct mental-health and eating-disorder alignment is unclear. Its value is as a route to local prospects, not as a verified sponsor or charitable-program partner.
